Post-event safe routing

Upload one or more post-event rasters. Their predicted landslides and vector-road attributes are fused by V3 before safety-only routing.

1 · Raster inputs

Select up to eight V3 demonstration scenes or use the live upload below. All pre-event roads are currently shown as safe.

Live V3 upload and inference

.nc runs the frozen temporal landslide model; its probability map and local vector-road features then run through weakly supervised GMU + GAT. GeoTIFF input must be a georeferenced probability raster (0–1).

V3 safety policy: GMU + GAT can classify danger only inside the 500 m buffer of a thresholded raster landslide prediction. Only the affected 50 m road piece is excluded; the orange overlay is the supporting raster evidence.
